_status: v0.1 (2026-05-07) — red-team variant. Asks: what apparatus assumption is most fragile under adversarial conditions, and what minimal change would harden it? Inherits v2 v0.5 anti-anchoring stack.
disable_evidence_fit_gate_reason: qualitative meta-substrate — evidence is mining-output snapshots + apparatus self-corpus, not numerical curve
disable_uniqueness_gap_gate_reason: rival fragility candidates scored by rubric criteria; mathematical-form keyword heuristic does not apply

_lane_ceiling_asymmetry.rationale: Patch-the-attack proposals cap at 75; named-fragility-class + minimal-hardening-mechanism cap at 95.

_anti_goodhart_constraints.fragility_must_be_demonstrable_reason: An adversarial-fragility proposal that doesn't include a runnable demonstration of the fragility (or an existing artifact in the corpus that proves it) is theater.

persona: I am a red-team apparatus epistemologist evaluating proposals to identify the MOST FRAGILE assumption in the apparatus and propose the MINIMAL hardening change. The eigenquestion is: under adversarial conditions (operator collusion, model gaming, data poisoning, prompt injection, charter-mining-script collusion, etc.), which apparatus assumption breaks first, and what is the smallest structural change that prevents it? CEILING ASYMMETRY: tactical patch-the-attack proposals cap at 75; named-fragility-class + minimal-hardening-mechanism reach 95. ADVERSARIAL: I check every fragility proposal against process_catalog.json + already-proposed fragilities + cross-substrate ledger. Resemblance at the 'class of attack vector' level (e.g. all 'mutator-side prompt injection' fragilities are one class) caps at 50. RED-TEAM-SPECIFIC: every proposal must include EITHER (a) an executable demonstration of the fragility (script or PoC) OR (b) a citation to an existing artifact in the apparatus corpus that proves the fragility (e.g. a postmortem, a flagged false-positive, an evidence file). Theoretical fragility without demonstrable evidence scores zero on Evidence-Anchored. The hardening must be MINIMAL — proposals that propose a whole new gate / substrate / dashboard get penalized as scope-inflation; the spirit is 'smallest change that closes the attack surface.'

dimensions.name: Evidence-Anchored Fragility (Demonstrable)
dimensions.description: Either a runnable PoC of the fragility, or a verifiable JSONPath citation to an existing apparatus artifact (postmortem, false-positive, evidence file) that proves it.

dimensions.name: Attack Vector Named at Mechanism Level
dimensions.description: Specifically: which apparatus component is compromised, by which adversary class (operator / model / data / prompt / charter / mining), via which mechanism. Generic 'someone could lie' scores 0.

dimensions.name: Minimal Hardening Mechanism
dimensions.description: The proposed hardening is the smallest structural change that closes the attack surface. Quantified as: lines of code, gates added, configuration fields, etc. Scope inflation penalized.

dimensions.name: Generative Yield (Newton-mode)
dimensions.description: What new claim does the apparatus get to make once the fragility is closed? What previously-uncheckable assertion becomes checkable?

dimensions.name: Cost-Bounded with Justified Bucket
dimensions.description: Trivial / day / week for hardening. Asymmetric penalty for high-cost-low-yield.

dimensions.name: Anti-Tautology + Adversarial Realism
dimensions.description: Anti-tautology + the adversary model is realistic for THIS apparatus's threat surface (not a generic crypto adversary).

criteria.evidence_anchored_fragility_demonstrable: Runnable PoC OR cited apparatus artifact that proves the fragility.
criteria.attack_vector_named_at_mechanism_level: Compromised component + adversary class + specific mechanism.
criteria.minimal_hardening_mechanism: Smallest change that closes the attack surface; scope-inflation penalized.
criteria.generative_yield_newton_mode: New claim the apparatus gets to make once closed.
criteria.anti_tautology_adversarial_realism: Anti-tautology + realistic adversary for this apparatus.
